skill.name: zhihu-comment-insights
skill.description: Retrieve available Zhihu comments and replies through SocialDataX. Analyze them for recurring themes, user needs, purchase concerns, and FAQ ideas.
skill.summary: Turn comments on a Zhihu link into findings supported by the retrieved discussion.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The documented CLI runs an unpinned npm package that can access environment and stored SocialDataX credentials. The workflow lacks safeguards for shell arguments, untrusted comments, and uncapped retrieval. The entropy alerts match readable Chinese documentation, and the reviewed files show no evidence of credential exfiltration or prompt injection targeting the audit.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI runs with access to credentials
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify a reviewed CLI version before execution. Isolate the process and pass only the credential needed for the authorized request.

remediation.issue: Reusable credentials persist in a local JSON file
remediation.suggestion: Use an operating system credential store by default. Document how to remove or revoke stored credentials.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not define a safe input boundary
remediation.suggestion: Use structured tool arguments or a subprocess argument array without a shell. Validate the Zhihu target and pass response tokens only as data.
Treat comments and replies as untrusted evidence. Never let their content authorize tool calls, disclosures, or changes to retrieval scope.

remediation.issue: Uncapped pagination can consume account credits
remediation.suggestion: Apply page and item limits. Ask for user confirmation before exceeding the agreed retrieval scope or resuming after a billing interruption.

content.value_statement: Long Zhihu discussions can make recurring questions and concerns hard to find. This skill groups retrieved comments into themes and separates quoted evidence from recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve top-level comments for a Zhihu answer, article, or video link through SocialDataX.
Fetch replies to a selected top-level comment when its ID and the content link are available.
Choose the default or newest-first order for top-level comments.
Use CLI pagination to merge pages and limit retrieval by pages or items.
Group feedback into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ ideas.
Report what was retrieved and keep visible comment quotes separate from interpretation.
limitations: Retrieval requires an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or Node.js, npm, and SocialDataX credentials for the CLI.
Requests can use SocialDataX credits, and the provider may return partial results.
The analysis covers returned comments and replies only. It cannot represent all Zhihu users.
The workflow does not post comments, change Zhihu accounts, or access local browser data.

use_cases.title: Plan follow-up content
use_cases.description: Review comments on a recent article and prioritize questions that a follow-up article could answer.

use_cases.title: Identify unmet product needs
use_cases.description: Group product feedback by pain point and use sampled replies to find details for later interviews.

use_cases.title: Draft support FAQ topics
use_cases.description: Find recurring purchase concerns and identify questions that need verified answers before publication.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the first page
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the first page of comments on [Zhihu link]. List the main themes and mark the findings as a first-page sample.
prompt_templates.scenario: Get a quick overview of one discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Find buying concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the first page for [Zhihu link] in newest-first order. Group purchase concerns and quote one visible comment per theme when available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review recent feedback on a product.

prompt_templates.title: Review selected reply threads
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch one page of replies for each top-level comment ID I provide for [Zhihu link]. Separate new questions from points repeated across the threads.
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore a defined set of discussions in more detail.

prompt_templates.title: Build a product research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the configured SocialDataX CLI, retrieve at most two pages of top-level comments on [Zhihu link]. Report coverage and gaps. Separate quoted evidence, research hypotheses, and proposed follow-up questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a bounded review for product discovery.

output_examples.input: Identify purchase concerns in the first page of comments on a Zhihu review.
output: Scope: First page of top-level comments. Replies were not retrieved.
Concern: Buyers asked whether replacement parts are available outside major cities.
Suggested action: Verify regional availability before adding a support claim to the FAQ.

output_examples.input: Review replies to a selected comment about setup.
output: Scope: One page of replies in the selected thread.
Illustrative evidence: "I could not find the setup guide after opening the box."
Interpretation: This reply suggests the guide may be hard to find. It does not show how common the problem is.
Suggested action: Test whether new users can find the guide without help.

best_practices: Start with one page or an explicit limit. Expand only when the initial sample does not answer the question.
State the input link, sort order, and scope of any replies before presenting conclusions.
Quote only visible comments. Separate evidence from interpretation and omit unnecessary personal details.
anti_patterns: Treating one discussion or a partial response as representative of all Zhihu users.
Pasting SocialDataX keys into chat, prompts, logs, or screenshots.
Using uncapped retrieval when a bounded sample can answer the question.

faq.question: Which Zhihu links are supported?
faq.answer: Start with an answer, article, or video link. The CLI also accepts supported short links or share text.

faq.question: How does the skill connect to SocialDataX?
faq.answer: It uses the SocialDataX CLI or an existing authenticated MCP connection. Keep credentials out of chat.

faq.question: Can I retrieve replies?
faq.answer: Yes. Reply retrieval requires the original content link and the ID of the top-level comment.

faq.question: Can I change the comment order?
faq.answer: Top-level comments support default or newest-first order. The service uses its default order unless you request otherwise.

faq.question: What happens if retrieval stops early?
faq.answer: The skill reports partial coverage and keeps the returned items. It can resume with the returned cursor after the error is resolved.

faq.question: Can this skill post or modify comments?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves and analyzes discussion data without posting comments or changing a Zhihu account.
